items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It’s a cooperative trio. Larry Koontz on guitar and the vocal and flute

ctx.x: So you seem to have the focus on your projects with your family, and then you’re working – like I said, I saw you with Chick come through the new Yoshi’s, San Francisco, a couple years ago. It sounds like – now, Tierney Sutton. Are you working in her group?
The trio. No, it’s a trio. It’s a cooperative trio. Larry Koontz on guitar and the vocal and flute, which is a very, very unique situation I like a lot.
It must be easy to travel, too.
